value:work@4.value: paint the 2BHK flat, including both rooms, hall, kitchen, bathroom doors and balcony railing; two coats on the walls and one coat on the ceiling

value:balance@18.source_text: Baaki kaam poora hone ke baad, jis din finish karoge usi din. Pehle main kaam dekhungi, phir payment.
